question: Honoured with Padma Vibushan and Padma Bhushan, Kishori Amonkar was a renowned personality related to which of the following fields?
solution:
The correct answer is __music__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Kishori Amonkar was an Indian classical vocalist.
 
• She belonged to the Jaipur Gharana.
 
 
• Birth- April 10, 1932.
 
• Death- April 3, 2017.
 
• She also won Padma Bhushan (1987) and Padma Vibhushan (2002).
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__** 

 
• Jaipur Gharana :

 
 
• The Jaipur-Atrauli Gharana emerged from Alladiya Khan's family which originated from Atrauli and migrated to Jaipur.
 
• The Jaipur-Atrauli Gharana is Hindustani music founded by Alladiya Khan (1855–1946) in the late 19th century.
 
• The Gharana is known for its distinctive vocal aesthetics, raga repertoire, and technical aptitude.
 
• The chief exponents of the Jaipur Gharana are Alladiya Khan, Mallikarjun Mansur, Kesarbhai Kerkar, Kishori Amonkar, and Shruti Sadolikar, Padma Talwalkar and Ashwini Bhide Deshpande.
